title: One-Pot Tomato Spinach Pasta
description: A pantry-friendly pasta with tomatoes and spinach in one pot.
substitutions: Use any short pasta with similar cooking time.

steps.text: Combine pasta, tomatoes, broth, and seasoning.

cookSteps.text: Put 8 ounces pasta, 1 can diced tomatoes, 2 1/2 cups broth or water, and 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning in a large pot.
Bring to a boil, then simmer 12–15 minutes, stirring often, until the pasta is tender and most liquid is absorbed.
Stir in 2 cups spinach until wilted. Add 1/2 cup cheese if using.

title: Apple Cinnamon Baked Oatmeal
description: Soft baked oats with apples and cinnamon for easy breakfasts.
substitutions: Use maple syrup instead of brown sugar.

steps.text: Heat oven to 350°F and grease an 8-inch dish.
Mix all ingredients and spread in the dish.

cookSteps.text: Heat oven to 350°F and grease an 8-inch baking dish.
Mix 2 cups oats, 1 1/2 cups milk, 1 egg, 1 diced apple, 2 tablespoons brown sugar, 1 teaspoon cinnamon, and 1 teaspoon baking powder. Spread in the dish.
Bake 28–30 minutes until the center is set and the edges are lightly browned.

title: Chickpea Salad Sandwiches
description: Creamy mashed chickpea filling for a quick sandwich or wrap.
substitutions: Use plain yogurt for part of the mayonnaise.
Serve in wraps or lettuce cups.

steps.text: Mix in mayonnaise, mustard, celery or pickle, and pepper.

cookSteps.text: Mash 1 drained can chickpeas in a bowl, leaving a little texture.
Mix in 3 tablespoons mayonnaise, 1 teaspoon mustard, 2 tablespoons celery or pickle if using, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper.
Divide the filling among 4 sandwiches using 8 slices bread.

title: Garlic Parmesan Cabbage Noodles
description: Tender cabbage and noodles tossed with garlic, butter, and parmesan.
substitutions: Use nutritional yeast instead of parmesan.

steps.text: Cook cabbage in butter 8 minutes; add garlic for 1 minute.
Toss with noodles, parmesan, and pepper.

cookSteps.text: Cook 8 ounces egg noodles according to the package, then drain.
Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet. Add 4 cups cabbage and cook 8 minutes until tender and lightly browned.
Add 2 minced garlic cloves and cook 1 minute.
Toss in the drained noodles, 1/2 cup parmesan, and 1/4 teaspoon black pepper.
